attempts.summary: Implemented, via an Ansible playbook run from control node4, a VyOS destination-NAT port-forward on node1 that publishes node2's TCP/8080 application (on the private "lan" network node1+node2 share) to node3, while default-dropping all other forwarded traffic so the rest of the private network stays closed to node3. All four managed nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory evidence protocol, with boot-identity change and service/config recovery confirmed on each.
